reason: Independent pre-run review found that the proposed experiment did not validly reopen the parked portfolio-covariance lane and could not produce a leakage-free chronological holdout under the locked design.

blocking_findings.detail: The parked lane requires an owner-level prospective acceptance-clause revision before a new experiment. Creating that revision inside the same experiment would let the experiment authorize itself.

The parked contract permits one batch re-judgment of all 31 ranked representatives after a valid owner revision; the ticket fixed only the 11 already materialized and historically selected representatives.

Eight of eleven old_thin trade sets contain exits after 2025-04-22. Using their complete lifecycle to estimate eligibility, volatility, or correlation consumes mid_weak prices and PnL before weights are frozen.

The active 2026-07-12 post-MTM baseline explicitly forbids cross-protocol EV, Sharpe, and drawdown comparison, while the prior overlay summaries use the 2026-06-04 core and source-dependent MTM proxy calendars.

A twelve-row candidates-plus-joint panel omits core-only and does not represent the original 31-family selection set (or the wider historical search). Synthetic shifted dates would conceal overlapping real dates rather than repair the chronological split.

additional_design_defects: sum(weights)=0.10 with a 0.025 family cap is infeasible when fewer than four families remain eligible; a valid contract needs sum(weights)<=0.10, cash residual, and zero-volatility/missing-score fallbacks.
The locked score uses only each family's volatility and correlation to core. It does not use candidate-by-candidate covariance, so calling it a joint covariance allocator overstates the mechanism.

Source artifacts mix base notionals and concurrent trade counts. Coefficients summing to 10 percent do not imply a 10 percent capital or risk budget without common unit-capital/target-vol normalization and name-level overlap caps.
Prior MTM reconstruction books the full cost residual on exit. Truncating training at 2025-04-22 would omit already-incurred entry cost unless costs are split causally between entry and exit.
Because the candidate families were selected using all three canonical windows, later windows can only be described as weight-fit pseudo-holdouts or conditional OOT, never untouched OOS.
required_redesign: Obtain an owner-level prospective lane revision independently of the experiment reservation.
Use the complete 31-family scope required by the parked-lane contract, or choose a genuinely new data source/gate outside this parked surface.
Replay every configuration from raw trade rows on one active post-MTM calendar and cost contract; do not reuse old combined or delta summaries.
Define a real-calendar train/holdout boundary: training information must stop on 2025-04-22, with open-position state and later PnL assigned prospectively to holdout under a predeclared rule.
Declare the full selection history and include at least core-only, every eligible single-family configuration, and the joint configuration in the DSR evidence; do not shift dates synthetically.
